""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Concept used

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Income = Expenditure + savings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Calculation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Let Rumi's income be 100x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Her savings = 100x × 20/100 = 20x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                New income = 100x × 130/100 = 130x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                New expenditure = 80x × 140/100 = 112x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                New savings = 130x - 112x = 18x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Income decrement = 20x - 18x = 2x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2x → 750

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                100x → 750 × 50 = 37500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The answer is 37500.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                प्रयुक्त संकल्पना

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                आय = व्यय + बचत

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                गणना

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                माना रुमी की आय 100x है

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                उसकी बचत = 100x × 20/100 = 20x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                नई आय = 100x × 130/100 = 130x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                नया व्यय = 80x × 140/100 = 112x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                नई बचत = 130x - 112x = 18x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                आय वृद्धि = 20x - 18x = 2x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2x → 750

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                100x → 750 × 50 = 37500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                उत्तर 37500 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n", "te": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఉపయోగించిన భావన    

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ఆదాయం = ఖర్చు + పొదుపు

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 वापरलेली संकल्पना

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                उत्पन्न = खर्च + बचत

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                गणना

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                रुमीचे उत्पन्न 100x असू द्या

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                तिची बचत = 100x x 20/100 = 20x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                नवीन उत्पन्न = 100x x 130/100 = 130x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                नवीन खर्च = 80x x 140/100 = 112x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                नवीन बचत = 130x - 112x = 18x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                उत्पन्न घट = 20x - 18x = 2x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2x → 750

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                100x → 750 x 50 = 37500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                उत्तर 37500 आहे.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n", "bn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ধারণা ব্যবহার করা হয়েছে

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                আয় = ব্যয় + সঞ্চয়

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                হিসাব

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                রুমির আয় 100 গুণ হোক

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                তার সঞ্চয় = 100x x 20/100 = 20x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                নতুন আয় = 100x x 130/100 = 130x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                নতুন ব্যয় = 80x x 140/100 = 112x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                নতুন সঞ্চয় = 130x - 112x = 18x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                আয় হ্রাস = 20x - 18x = 2x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2x → 750

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                100x → 750 x 50 = 37500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                উত্তর হল 37500।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n", "ml": "", "gu": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                સિદ્ધાંત

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                આવક = ખર્ચ + બચત

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ગણતરી

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ધારો કે રૂમીની આવક 100x છે,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                તેની બચત = 100x × 20/100 = 20x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                નવી આવક = 100x × 130/100 = 130x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                નવો ખર્ચ = 80x × 140/100 = 112x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                નવી બચત = 130x - 112x = 18x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                આવકમાં ઘટાડો = 20x - 18x = 2x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2x → 750

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                100x → 750 x 50 = 37500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                સાચો જવાબ 37500 છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n", "kn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ಬಳಸಿದ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ಆದಾಯ = ವೆಚ್ಚ + ಉಳಿತಾಯ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ರುಮಿ ಅವರ ಆದಾಯ 100x ಎಂದು ಭಾವಿಸೋಣ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ಅವರ ಉಳಿತಾಯ = 100x x 20/100 = 20x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ಹೊಸ ಆದಾಯ = 100x x 130/100 = 130x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ಹೊಸ ವೆಚ್ಚ = 80x x 140/100 = 112x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ಹೊಸ ಉಳಿತಾಯ = 130x - 112x = 18x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ಆದಾಯದಲ್ಲಾದ ಇಳಿಕೆ = 20x - 18x = 2x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2x → 750

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                100x → 750 x 50 = 37500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ಉತ್ತರ 37500.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n", "ta": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                பயன்படுத்தப்பட்ட கருத்து

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                வருமானம் = செலவு + சேமிப்பு

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                கணக்கீடு

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ரூமியின் வருமானம் 100x ஆக இருக்கட்டும்

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                அவருடைய சேமிப்பு = 100x x 20/100 = 20x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                புதிய வருமானம் = 100x x 130/100 = 130x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                புதிய செலவு = 80x x 140/100 = 112x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                புதிய சேமிப்பு = 130x - 112x = 18x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                வருமானக் குறைவு = 20x - 18x = 2x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                2x → 750

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                100x → 750 x 50 = 37500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                பதில் 37500.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ The ratio of mixtures is 4 : 11.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Concept Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Use the concept of weighted average to determine the ratio in which the mixtures were combined.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Weighted average formula:\\( \\text{Final percentage} = \\frac{a \\times \\text{percentage of mixture A} + b \\times \\text{percentage of mixture B}}{a + b} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Mixture A (original): 35% syrup

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Mixture B (replacement): 20% syrup

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Final mixture: 24% syrup

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Using the weighted average formula:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \\( 0.35 \\times (1 - x) + 0.20 \\times x = 0.24 \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                0.35 - 0.35x + 0.20x = 0.24

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                0.35 - 0.15x = 0.24

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                0.15x = 0.35 - 0.24

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                0.15x = 0.11

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \\(x = \\frac{0.11}{0.15} \\) \\( x = \\frac{11}{15} \\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Fraction of mixture A replaced = 11/15

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Fraction of mixture A remaining = 1 - 11/15 = 4/15

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                So, the ratio of mixture A and mixture B = 4/15 : 11/15 = 4 : 11

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                So, the ratio in which these mixtures were mixed to obtain the new mixture is 4:11.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                ∴ मिश्रण का अनुपात 4 : 11 है।
