                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Challenge

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Dare"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Chagrin"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Exert"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Acceptance"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The correct answer is "Dare."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • "Challenge" means to invite somebody to fight, play, argue, etc. against you. (मुक़ाबले की चुनौती देना; ललकारना)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: They’ve challenged us to a football match this Saturday.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Synonym of Challenge is Dare.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The word "Dare" means to have enough courage to do something. (साहस करना)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: She dared to climb the highest peak in the region.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The correct answer is Option 1.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Chagrin (Option 2) means distress or embarrassment caused by failure or disappointment. (निराशा या खीज, खिसियाहट, संताप)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Exert (Option 3) means to put forth effort or energy towards a task. (किसी वस्‍तु को प्रयोग में लाना (जैसे प्रभाव, ताक़त आदि))
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Acceptance (Option 4) means the action of consenting to receive or undertake something offered. (स्‍वीकार करने या स्‍वीकार्य होने की क्रिया)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \nDirection: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Obscure"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Reduce"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Hinder"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Promote"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The correct answer is "Promote."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • "Hamper" means to hinder or impede progress or movement. (अवरुद्घ होना, रुकना)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: The building work was hampered by bad weather.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • "Promote" means to support or encourage the growth or development of something. (किसी बात को प्रोत्‍साहित करना; किसी बात के होने या बढ़ने में सहायता करना)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: We need to promote her activities.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Therefore, the antonym of hamper is promote.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The correct answer is Option 4.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Obscure means to make unclear or difficult to understand. (किसी वस्‍तु या प्रसंग को धुँधला या दुर्बोध बना देना)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Reduce means to make smaller in size or quantity. (मात्रा, क़ीमत, आकार आदि की दृष्टि से घटाना; छोटा करना)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Hinder means to make it difficult for something to happen or progress. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के लिए कठिनाई पैदा करना, किसी के काम में बाधा डालना)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The correct answer is "broke into."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The phrasal verb "broke into" means to enter a building or place forcibly or illegally. (किसी भवन या स्थान में जबरन या अवैध रूप से प्रवेश करना)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: Two raiders broke into his home.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • It is the correct option to use in this sentence because Robinhood entered the mansion without permission.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The correct preposition to use with "broke" in this context is "into", not "to" or "up to."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The correct answer is Option 3.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Correct sentence: Robinhood broke into the mansion to collect some food and money for the poor.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Option 1 (broke upto) is grammatically incorrect and does not make sense in this context.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Option 2 (broke in) is close to the correct answer, but it is missing the preposition "into" which is necessary to convey the meaning of entering forcibly.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Option 4 (broke to) is incorrect because "to" is not the correct preposition to use with "broke" in this context.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The word 'dermatology' is a noun that refers to the study of skin and its diseases.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     \n\t\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • It comes from the Greek words 'derma' (skin) and 'logia' (study of).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The field of dermatology includes the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of skin conditions.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \nKey Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • "Specify" means to say or name something clearly or in detail. (स्‍पष्‍टता या विस्‍तार से कुछ कहना या किसी का उल्‍लेख करना)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The fire regulations specify the maximum number of people allowed in.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The synonym of "specify" is "define."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • "Define" means to state or explain the meaning of something clearly and precisely. (किसी बात का अर्थ स्पष्ट और सटीक रूप से बताना या समझाना)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: We will define the rules afterwards.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The correct answer is Option 4.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • "Brief" means short or concise. (संक्षिप्‍त या अल्‍पकालिक)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • "Refute" means to prove something wrong or false.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The given sentence is in the Simple Future Tense and in Active Voice.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The rule for changing a Simple Future Tense from Active voice to Passive voice:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Subject + will + V1 + object (Active Voice)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Object + will + be + V3 + by Subject (Passive Voice) 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • A song will be sung by Esha.​ (Passive Voice)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The subject is "letter" and the object is "peon" in the passive voice.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The smell of _______ (formerly) brewed coffee wafted through the air, beckoning him to start his day.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "hitherto"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "quickly"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "preserved"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "subsequently"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The correct answer is "subsequently."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The word "formerly" means previously or in the past. (अतीत में; अब से पहले)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The European Union was formerly called the European Community.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The antonym of "formerly" is "subsequently."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • "Subsequently" means afterward or later. (बाद में, तदनंतर)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Example: The rumours were subsequently found to be untrue.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The sentence suggests that the smell of coffee is inviting the person to start their day.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The use of "wafted through the air" creates a sensory image of the aroma spreading around.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The correct answer is Option 4.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Correct sentence: The smell of subsequently brewed coffee wafted through the air, beckoning him to start his day.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \nAdditional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Option 1 (hitherto) means until now or up to a particular time. (अभी तक)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Option 2 (quickly) means at a fast pace or with speed. (जल्‍दी, शीघ्र; थोड़े समय में)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Option 3 (preserved) means to maintain or keep something in its original state. (किसी वस्‍तु को सुरक्षित या अच्‍छी हालत में रखना)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n5f:Tb0d,\n
